note: Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the batch_661 wallace_2026_s2_perf cache; sha256 matches; the Study 2 .sps contains no profcert text). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2_profcert.csv = (s2, profcert{i} -> profcert{i}, i = 1,2,3), rev flag 0, no flip, so item IS the source column name: exempt from Step 5b, no verification files. The script docstring lists _s2_profcert among tables running 1 = low ... 7 = high, which the value labels confirm with no recode. Variable labels shipped verbatim: profcert1 = How confident are you that the professor's beliefs are what you indicated in the previous questions?; profcert2 = How sure are you of your responses to the previous questions about the professor's intelligence beliefs?; profcert3 = How certain do you feel that your responses to the previous questions capture the professor's beliefs? OPTIONS: all three items value-labelled 1 = 'Not at all1', 2..6 bare digits, 7 = 'Very much7' (Qualtrics concatenation artifact); shipped Not at all / Very much with the trailing digits stripped (same convention as wallace_2026_certain), 2-6 blank, not padded. 'The previous questions' are the four professor-mindset items IQB1, IQB2R, IQB3, IQB4, which immediately precede profcert1-3 in the .sav and sit in wallace_2026_mcm_check (Study 2 rows); no lead-in text in the .sav or .sps, so instructions left blank. Sanity counts (not required for the exemption): source 838 rows, 838 non-missing per item; live 2514 rows = 838 ids x 3; item resp-count vectors source = live exactly: profcert1 16/22/40/78/202/255/225, profcert2 8/15/37/94/194/258/232, profcert3 11/20/35/101/212/247/212; means 5.50/5.57/5.47; inter-item r = 0.78-0.82, all positive (no reverse-worded item). Direction cross-check: the profcert mean correlates +0.50 with the extremity of the IQB professor-belief ratings (|mean(IQB1,IQB3,IQB4) - 4|) and +0.39 with the personal certainty mean (certain1-3, same Not at all..Very much labels), consistent with 1 = Not at all ... 7 = Very much. Dictionary Description: Certainty about the instructor's mindset. Rights: study-authored items; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission). Not in instrument_rights_register.csv; no register row written.
public_note: The items ask about 'the previous questions', which are the four ratings of the professor's intelligence beliefs (IQB1, IQB2R, IQB3, IQB4) held in wallace_2026_mcm_check for Study 2.
